newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher, buoyed by exporters.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher, buoyed by exporters.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended higher on Monday, as the yen's slump against the dollar spurred buying in major export-oriented issues such as electronics and cars, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average closed up 185.72 points or 0.91 percent at 20,575.26, after briefly rising as high as 20,600.66. September Nikkei futures climbed 160 to 20,580.

"Our next focus will be Sony's first quarter earnings, to be released on July 31. If the report shows robust earnings growth, buying could spread to other electronics issues," said Tetsuya Ishijima, chief strategist at Okasan Securities.
